results.title: Introducing Superagent: A Multi-Agent System for Work | Airtable
results.description: Now we're making the same bet on AI agents. And the breakthrough isn't a smarter single agent; it's multiple agents working together. Today, we’re announcing Superagent, our first standalone product built on multi-agent coordination. When you ask Superagent a question, you're not getting one AI assistant doing sequential tasks.
extra_snippets: Now we're making the same bet on AI agents. And the breakthrough isn't a smarter single agent; it's multiple agents working together. Today, we’re announcing Superagent, our first standalone product built on multi-agent coordination. When you ask Superagent a question, you're not getting one AI assistant doing sequential tasks.

This approach reflects what I call 'inside out' product thinking: start with what's now technically possible at the frontier of technology, then work backward to create the right product experience. Multi-agent systems represent that frontier today. Superagent is built on our acquisition of DeepSky and reflects our broader momentum in AI – from hiring David Azose as CTO after he led ChatGPT's business products at OpenAI, to launching Airtable for ChatGPT, to refounding as an AI-native platform.

Superagent takes all the parallel work streams and weaves them into a coherent, polished deliverable – not a wall of text, but a rich, interactive artifact, custom-built for your question. You're not prompting an AI. You're orchestrating a team. That's the difference between asking a traditional chat product to research a competitor and asking Superagent: instead of a sequential summary built by one agent working through tasks one at a time, Superagent deploys a coordinated team to investigate multiple dimensions simultaneously, then delivers an interactive competitive landscape ready to present.

You get their regulatory posture, recent AI investments with deal details, competitive pressures they're facing, and the specific pain points your product addresses. It's pitch prep that's actually ready to use. What if every task you tackled came with New York Times-quality data visualization? That would have been unfathomable five years ago. With Superagent's multi-agent architecture, it's the default.

results.description: Many AI-powered products face risks from prompt injections, malicious tool calls, and backdoors that can compromise systems or data. Superagent AI acts as a secure proxy with its Guard model, detecting and blocking these unsafe inputs in real time, thereby safeguarding AI applications and their underlying models.

items.question: What is Superagent AI?
items.answer: Superagent AI is a platform designed to provide runtime protection, security, and compliance for AI applications. It offers purpose-trained models—Guard, Verify, and Redact—that act as guardrails to protect AI systems in real time. Superagent can be used as a secure proxy between your apps, models, and tools, ensuring safe and compliant AI operations.
items.title: Superagent Review 2026 | Legal, Risk & Compliance Tool - Pricing ...

items.question: What are the main features of Superagent AI?
items.answer: The main features of Superagent AI include Guard, which detects and blocks unsafe inputs, prompt injections, malicious tool calls, and backdoors before they reach your models; Verify, which validates model outputs against enterprise sources and policies to ensure every generation is factual and compliant; Redact, which automatically removes sensitive data like PII, PHI, and secrets from text, logs, or documents; Unified Observability, offering centralized policies, audits, and compliance logs for complete visibility; Agent-native functionality, purpose-built for prompts, tool calls, function invocations, and file attachments; and Low-latency optimization, designed for real-time protection in production environments.
items.title: Superagent Review 2026 | Legal, Risk & Compliance Tool - Pricing ...

items.question: How does Superagent AI work?
items.answer: Superagent AI acts as a secure proxy between your applications and AI models. It inspects prompts, validates tool calls, and blocks threats in real time. It uses purpose-trained models to detect and prevent attacks, validate outputs, and redact sensitive information. Superagent also provides structured logs and audits for compliance and security monitoring.
